[sws_section][sws_split img="instructor-scope" alt="Southwestern Solutions instructor observing a tactical operator during training" badge="Years of Experience" badge_num="50+"] Our Mission

Prepare the Instructors Who Prepare Everyone Else

Southwestern Solutions is a San Diego–based provider of POST-certified law enforcement instructor training. We focus on the disciplines where training quality has the greatest impact on public safety, officer safety and agency liability: chemical agents and less-lethal munitions.

Our instructors are former and current Law Enforcement Tactical Operators with over 50 years of experience. We bring that experience to every class: critical response tactics, Mobile Field Force, basic to advanced Chemical Agent deployments, Long Rifle utilization in urban and rural environments, Close Quarter Techniques and High Risk Warrant Planning.

item.title: AB 48 Compliance Training
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
What Is AB 48?

Assembly Bill 48 (2021) added Section 13652 to the Penal Code, effective January 1, 2022. It restricts how law enforcement agencies may use kinetic energy projectiles and chemical agents to disperse an assembly, protest or demonstration — and it ties lawful use directly to training.

Under PC 13652, only officers who have received POST-standard training in crowd-control use may deploy these tools in those situations.

[sws_notice title="AB 48 — Certifications Prior to January 2022"]Assembly Bill 48 states that any kinetic energy projectiles and chemical agents shall only be deployed by a peace officer that has received training on their proper use by the Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST), starting January 2022. All previous certifications prior to January 2022 have been de-certified. Southwestern Solutions Chemical Agent and Less Lethal Instructor Courses meet AB 48 requirements and are POST certified.[/sws_notice]

The Core Requirements

Under PC 13652, kinetic energy projectiles and chemical agents may be used in crowd situations only when objectively reasonable to defend against a threat to life or serious bodily injury, or to bring an objectively dangerous and unlawful situation safely and effectively under control — and only in accordance with conditions that include:

  • Attempting de-escalation and other reasonable alternatives when objectively reasonable.
  • Repeated, audible announcements of the intent to use these tools and the type to be used, in a manner and languages likely to be understood, when objectively reasonable.
  • Reasonable efforts to distinguish individuals engaged in violent acts from those who are not, and targeting only those engaged in violent acts.
  • Providing an objectively reasonable opportunity to disperse and leave the scene.
  • Never aiming kinetic energy projectiles at the head, neck or other vital organs.
  • Not deploying solely because of a curfew violation, a verbal threat or noncompliance with a directive.
  • Ensuring medical aid is available or summoned after deployment.

Reporting Obligations

AB 48 also requires agencies to publish on their websites a summary of each incident in which these tools were used to disperse a crowd (Penal Code 13652.1). Accurate documentation starts in training.

How Southwestern Solutions Helps

  • Our Chemical Agent Instructor Course teaches AB 48 / PC 13652 directly inside its 40-hour curriculum.
  • Our Less Lethal Instructor Course covers AB 48 requirements and compliance throughout its 30 hours.
  • Graduates return with lesson plans, drills and documentation practices that support your agency's policy and reporting.
[sws_cta title="Make AB 48 Compliance Second Nature" text="Certify instructors who can teach the law, the tactics and the documentation as one system." button="View Courses" url="/courses/"]

This summary is for training and educational purposes only and is not legal advice. Refer to the full text of Penal Code sections 13652 and 13652.1, current POST guidelines and your agency's legal counsel.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
[sws_section eyebrow="Answers" title="Common Questions"]
How long is the Chemical Agent Instructor Course?

It is a 40-hour, instructor-level course combining classroom instruction, practical deployment work and scenario exercises.

Is the course POST certified and reimbursable?

Yes. The course is POST certified and listed as Plan IV reimbursable, which covers tuition. Travel and per diem are not reimbursed under Plan IV — confirm eligibility with your agency training manager.

How long is the Less Lethal Instructor Course?

It is a 30-hour, instructor-level course that blends legal standards, platform operation, practical drills and teaching methodology.

Is it AB 48 compliant?

Yes. The course covers AB 48 requirements and compliance for kinetic energy projectiles used in crowd-control situations, including targeting restrictions and documentation.

What does POST Plan IV reimbursement cover?

Plan IV reimburses tuition for eligible POST-certified courses. It does not cover travel or per diem. Your agency training manager can confirm eligibility and submit the request.

How do I register?

Use the contact form or call +1 (928) 614-0964. Our team confirms seat availability, sends registration details and answers Plan IV questions.

Can we host a course at our agency?

Yes. Agencies with a classroom and a suitable outdoor training area can host a session. Visit our Host a Course page or contact us to discuss dates.

Where are you located?

Southwestern Solutions is based in San Diego and delivers courses in San Diego County and at host agencies.

[/sws_section] [sws_section][sws_cta ][/sws_section]

Information We Collect

When you submit our contact or registration request form we collect the details you provide: name, agency, email, phone, course of interest and message. Our website may also collect standard technical data such as IP address and browser type through server logs and analytics.

How We Use It

We use your information only to respond to your inquiry, manage course registration, send course-related communications and improve our website. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies & Analytics

We may use cookies and analytics tools to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

Your Rights

You may request access to or deletion of your personal information at any time. Contact us at info@southwesternsolutions.org.
